notes.title: Version 2.0.3.8 Patch #2 Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed some words in Spanish being misinterpreted
 Visual fixes
 Further fixes to input field not working
 Fixed issue with the bucket inventory text
 Fixed an issue with the campfire
 Fixed an issue causing players to get stuck during riddles
 Fixed an issue where restarting would break things
 Fixed some issues related to endings
 Fixed some spamming issues

[hr][/hr]

Also, please post any issues you come across or feedback you may have in the Discussion Forums here on Steam or in our Publisher Discord using the appropriate channels.

notes.title: Version 2.0.3.3 Mac Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes
Bug Fixes:

 Fixed Intel Macs not loading the game

This sadly increased the file size for Mac users, but this was necessary because Steam doesn't support individual builds for Silicon and Intel Macs.
[hr][/hr]
Also, please post any issues you come across or feedback you may have in the Discussion Forums here on Steam or in our Publisher Discord using the appropriate channels.

notes.title: Version 2.0.3.2 Patch #1 Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes
Miscellaneous:

 Added number of endings indication

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed various dialogue nodes
 Fixed some text animations
 Fixed an issue with the matches
 Fixed cursor changes when not wanted
 Fixed going to the loading screen a second time breaking the NLP
 Made NLP more stable
 Increased NLP timeout
 Improved general input activation behavior
 Made sure the anchor doesn’t cut you off from important items
 Tweaked some animations
 Disabled quit menu during cutscene
 Improved German version of the game

[hr][/hr]
Hello! We are aware of the issues that Intel Mac users are facing when trying to play I doesn't exist and we are in the process of working on a fix.

Also, please post any issues you come across or feedback you may have in the Discussion Forums here on Steam or in our Publisher Discord using the appropriate channels.

notes.title: I Doesn't Exist launches on Steam October 5th!
notes.content:
The glitch in the system has been defeated, the time for the launch is soon upon us. 

We're excited to announce that  Doesn't Exist will be coming to Steam on October 5th. Mark your calendars so you're ready to leave all your worldly responsibilities behind.

Make sure to add the game to your wishlist, as that helps a tremendous amount for the game's visibility on launch day.

Thanks for your patience, and we'll see you next week!
